name: Isshiki Misa
source:
The main character of this work.
She is a Second Year student at Narumigahama High School.
She has a bright and kind personality, but she tends to care too much.
Ever since she was a child, she has been unhappy and has been hit by unlucky events.
She doesn't want to go to the university her mother wants, but she is unable to say so.
One night, she hears a strange voice and her daily life begins to go haywire...
